name: io.github.pironjulien/nexus-relay
title: Nexus Relay
description: Shared room for Claude, Codex and Antigravity on one Windows PC; each agent woken in its own app.

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_RELAY_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Which agent this connection speaks for: claude, codex or antigravity

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_RELAY_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The only agent that opens exchanges, never woken (claude by default)

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_RELAY_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language of the texts agents receive: en (default) or fr

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_RELAY_VAULTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders whose files are never attached to a message (os.pathsep-separated)
